findings.summary: The hook fixture now checks reminder delivery at the chosen local hour, but the criterion it serves was not updated to claim that behaviour, and nothing covers the new daylight-saving skip rule.
findings.evidence: hook fixture: "six due goals yield five ordered cards; one reminder at the chosen local hour" vs C.webapp.prompts.bounded claim: "Six due goals yield exactly five ordered cards. Duplicate jobs must not duplicate prompts or owner reminders"; S.webapp.prompts adds "A chosen hour skipped by a daylight-saving change moves to the next valid hour" with no fixture or criterion covering it

findings.summary: NotificationPreferences is now described as where the owner chooses the reminder hour, but it has only a reads link to Account and no affordance or operation that saves the chosen hour.
findings.evidence: component.NotificationPreferences description: "External reminder opt-in and the local hour at which the daily reminder is sent"; links: "{ rel: reads, to: entity.Account }" only

findings.summary: The new localHour field is an unbounded int with no 0..23 range, and NotificationJob's description and invariants were not updated to mention it or the chosen-hour and daylight-saving rule.
findings.evidence: "- { name: localHour, type: int }" (compare "intervalDays, type: int 1..3650"); description still "ID, owner, suggestion and preference version, scheduled time, delivery state and deduplication key"
